# T-1: Add preset candidate provider

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Create or expose a setup-facing preset list that combines core presets with available plugin preset contributions for a target project root.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The provider returns core presets when no plugin presets are available.
- The provider includes installed enabled plugin preset contributions for an existing project.
- The provider returns candidates in this order: core preset discovery order first, then enabled plugin packages in config order, then each package's preset contribution order; later duplicate keys replace earlier entries without changing the final key set.
- The provider respects existing registry count, size, path, and manifest bounds.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer extending `src/lib/presets.js` instead of duplicating registry merge logic in setup. Keep resolver behavior project-root-aware so downstream validation and UI candidates agree.

## Test Strategy
Unit-test candidate generation with core-only and installed-plugin fixtures.
